answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a long technical clauses, numbers at the end register, it stays short. The design leans on retroactive public goods funding mechanisms. The island of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Each submission hangs on the thread of a task receipt, and the quill is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
